name: Symbiotic
source:
Symbiotic is a sci-fi action drama visual novel with dark undertones, and a love story which will be a roller coaster of emotion. As Zaydin and company go through the rigorous training to master the use of their symbiote partners, they must overcome numerous obstacles and fight enemies far beyond their control, all while dealing with the emotions that come with being teenagers. The race is on for the survival of mankind in this grueling war with another world!

Zaydin is a young complicated kid trying to cope with the loss of his mother, an evil entity attempting to control his mind, and the war of the worlds waged by alien Symbiotes, who have come to eradicate or consume all life on earth. While attending SCAR institute, the principal of the establishment, Neolinus, acts as his caretaker/guardian, at the request of Zaydin’s deceased mother. Neolinus is seen as a pain in the ass to the young orphan. Elliosa and Kadin, the friends he never wanted, have extremely different views on Zayden. While Elliosa has a major crush on him, Kadin, being the protective big brother type (Even though they’re not related) sees him as a dangerous jerk, though the question of why he hates him so much still lingers. They are joined by their symbiote partners, Tama who belongs to Zaydin, Pinkie Elliosa’s loveable friend, and Spike the “tough guy” belonging to Kadin. Together with the rest of the school they will discover what it means to be at war, not only with the aliens but also with their own emotions.

[From [url=https://zonemasterproductions.net/projects/symbiotic]official website[/url]]
translation:
《Symbiotic》是一部带有黑暗基调的科幻动作剧情视觉小说，其中的爱情故事，也将带来过山车般的情感起伏。泽丁与伙伴们接受严苛训练，学习掌握共生体搭档的力量。他们既要克服重重阻碍，与远超自身控制范围的敌人交战，也要应对青春期的种种情绪。在这场与异界展开的艰苦战争中，人类必须与时间赛跑，争取生存！

泽丁是个内心复杂的少年。他既要承受丧母之痛，对抗试图操纵自己心智的邪恶存在，也要面对外星共生体掀起的世界之战——它们来到地球，要消灭或吞噬这里的一切生命。在SCAR学园就读期间，校长内奥利努斯受泽丁亡母所托，担任他的照顾者与监护人。然而，在这位年轻孤儿眼中，内奥利努斯只是个烦人的家伙。艾莉奥莎与凯丁，是他从没想结交的朋友，两人对泽丁的看法也截然不同。艾莉奥莎深深暗恋着他，而凯丁则像个保护欲旺盛的哥哥——尽管两人并无血缘关系——将他视为危险的混蛋。然而，凯丁究竟为何如此厌恶他，仍是个谜。他们还有各自的共生体搭档，泽丁的塔玛、艾莉奥莎可爱的朋友小粉，以及凯丁的“硬汉”斯派克。与学园中的其他人一起，他们将逐渐明白，战争意味着什么。战场上的敌人，既有外星生物，也有他们自己的情感。
